title: Telodestones
description: Edible compasses that send you to their lodestones!
body:
**Telodestones** lets you craft edible compasses, and eating one connected to a lodestone will teleport you to that lodestone's location!

Features:
- Craftable edible compasses, using farmable resources! Surround a compass with popped chorus fruit to make it delicious.
- Connecting a compass to a lodestone and eating it will teleport you on top of that lodestone!
- Edible compasses will always be edible, and offer zero calories, nutrition, or value!
- Far from home? The Telodestone still works, even in unloaded chunks!
- Eating a spinning lodestone compass will have... undesirable effects.
